text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: elevated error rates and quality regressions observed for model `text-gen-v3` in us-west-2 (serving tier). Auto-detect triggered at 2026-03-15T10:02:03Z. Pager fired for on-call SRE.
Alex Chen: seeing the same in tracing. Latency OK, but generation perplexity jump and customer complaints via support.
Maria Gomez: this looks like a recent canary deploy 10:58Z — possibly the v3 weight pushed to production pool.
Eli (SRE Lead): taking pager. tagging @Product Ops and @Support Jess. Initial triage: isolate traffic, gather metrics, and decide rollback or pin.
Alex Chen: pulled latest deploy history: `deploy/serving/text-gen-v3@2026-03-15T10:55:12` by ci-bot. Canary was 5% -> promoted at 10:58.
Product Ops: recommend pinning customers to `text-gen-v2` for now. We should prepare status page + customer advisory.
Support Jess: we already have ~7 incoming tickets referencing hallucinations and changed completions. One enterprise customer pasted examples and said outputs contain personal data incorrectly. Escalated to Legal.
Legal - Nina: got it. Need exact customer ids and examples; do not share broader technical details with customers. We'll coordinate messaging.
Eli (SRE Lead): mitigation plan: 1) remove promoted v3 from default routing, 2) pin default to v2, 3) run a controlled rollback of the v3 promotion, 4) monitor quality signals + error rate.
Alex Chen: can do routing change now. Command to remove weight from v3 (do not run without confirmation):
```
redwoodctl route update --model text-gen --region us-west-2 --variant text-gen-v3 --weight 0
redwoodctl route update --model text-gen --region us-west-2 --variant text-gen-v2 --weight 100
```
Maria Gomez: I'll stage a canary rollback to ensure no leftover pods: `k8s: scale deployment text-gen-v3-serving --replicas=0 -n prod-us-west-2` then verify cache invalidation.
IncidentBot: NOTE: applying routing change will cause short-lived 503 spikes for in-flight requests. Recommend a 2-minute maintenance window announcement on status page.
Product Ops: Draft for status page (short):
"Our engineering team is investigating an issue affecting text generation quality for the `text-gen` model in the US-West region. We are rolling back a recent model promotion and pinning traffic to a stable version while we verify outputs. Some customers may see brief interruptions. We will provide updates every 30 minutes until resolved."
Support Jess: Draft for customer-facing message (email/snippet):
"Hi — we’re currently investigating changes to text generation quality you may have seen. We’ve temporarily routed traffic to a previously stable model version while we investigate. If you continue to see problematic outputs, please reply with examples and your request IDs. We apologize for the disruption and will follow up with a timeline shortly."
Eli (SRE Lead): internal comm template for engineers (quick checklist):
- Who: SRE + Serving + Product Ops + Support + Legal on call
- What: rollback/pinning of `text-gen-v3` to `text-gen-v2` due to quality regression
- When: action taken at 2026-03-15T10:15Z
- Impact: transient 503s and potential message reordering for in-flight requests; temporary routing to v2 may change token usage/cost slightly
- Action owners: Eli (SRE) -> routing + monitoring, Alex (Serving) -> rollback/deploy, Maria (ML Ops) -> v3 artifact investigation, Product Ops -> customer comms, Support -> ticket triage

Alex Chen: routing change applied at 2026-03-15T10:18Z. Confirming traffic now at 100% v2 in us-west-2.
IncidentBot: SYSTEM: traffic split changed: text-gen-v2=100%, text-gen-v3=0% for region us-west-2.
Maria Gomez: scaling down v3 deployment now.
Support Jess: posting customer advisory to affected customers list. Including instructions to provide request IDs.
Product Ops: status page update posted at 2026-03-15T10:22Z. Link: https://status.redwood.example/incident/1795400123 (placeholder)
Eli (SRE Lead): monitoring key signals: generation perplexity, token distribution, error rate, latency. Setup alerts for regressions reverting.
Alex Chen: initial checks show perplexity back to expected range. Running a diff on eval prompts now.
Support Jess: ticket queue stabilized — new incoming reduced after advisory.
Product Ops: draft for enterprise notification (more formal):
"Subject: Temporary model routing change for text-generation in US-West
Body: Dear customer, we identified a regression in an automated model promotion. We have temporarily routed traffic to a stable model version (text-gen-v2) and are investigating the root cause. There is no evidence of customer data exfiltration. We will provide an RCA and timeline within 48 hours. For urgent issues please reply to this thread or contact your account team."
Legal - Nina: add "no evidence of data exfiltration" only if triage confirms logs and access controls show no anomalies. Otherwise say "under investigation."
Eli (SRE Lead): agreed. We'll avoid definitive wording until infra/forensics confirm.
Alex Chen: ML team found a config mismatch in the model transform stage — tokenization flags differed between v2 and v3 artifact. Maria to lead artifact rollback investigation.
Maria Gomez: ack. I’ll capture artifact hashes and diff in the incident doc.
Customer Ops - Dan: prepare a short CS script for account teams to use on calls:
"We’ve rolled back traffic to a stable model and are monitoring outputs closely. If you have example completions, please share them and we’ll prioritize triage. Expected follow-up: initial update within 30 minutes, full RCA within 48 hours."
Eli (SRE Lead): handoff plan: primary SRE (Eli) will remain until stabilization confirmed for 2 hours post-change, then handoff to oncall rotation with incident notes.
Alex Chen: leaving logs and command history in the incident doc: `/docs/incidents/1795400123/commands.log` (internal).
Product Ops: preparing final status page update to clear once metrics stable for 20 minutes. Draft line for closure: "Issue mitigated — traffic restored to stable model. Monitoring continues."
Support Jess: customer advisory sent to affected list at 2026-03-15T10:40Z.
IncidentBot: REMINDER: create postmortem ticket and tag `model-quality-regression` and `high-priority` once incident marked resolved.
Eli (SRE Lead): will open postmortem. Thanks team — good quick coordination.
Support Jess: adding a small FAQ for customers in the advisory: how to request a pin to a specific model version and where to find request IDs.
Maria Gomez: artifact investigation ongoing; will attach detailed ML diffs to the postmortem.
Legal - Nina: I'll coordinate wording for enterprise notices.
Customer Ops - Dan: account teams notified.
Alex Chen: closing thread in 10m unless new alerts.
Support Jess: +1.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT: update scheduled. Next automated check-in at 2026-03-15T10:52Z."
